title: Common definitions
description: What the files of an export share: IDs, times, days, the age categories, consents and counters of quota (section 4 of the text of the part).

context.description: The context of the submission, as the element <novatrail-canvas> gave it, in its own names.

history_length.description: How many events of the history the submission covers.

id.description: An ID, as api or app gives it.

age_category.description: An age category, by its code (R46).

consent_id.description: The ID of the consent record, which the minimal record keeps after deletion.

giver.description: Who gave the consent: the owner of the account of their own profile, by the statement that they are 18 or older; a parent, by the signed form; or the learner themselves, from the age of digital consent of their country (R116).

request_code.description: Beside a parent's consent, and only there: the code of the request, which the signed form names — ten characters of Crockford's base32 in two groups of five.

form.description: Beside a parent's consent: where the scan of the signed form stands — none sent; sent, and checked by the operator or accepted once the consent is confirmed; or not accepted, so that a new one is sent.

age_category.description: The age category the consent was given for.

method.description: How the consent was checked: the owner's dated statement for an adult, the signed form (and later a card transaction) for a child.

confirmed_at.description: When the consent was confirmed; absent while it waits.

items.description: A legal text the person saw: one of them.

texts.description: The versions of the legal texts the person saw when they gave the consent — privacy-policy and terms-of-use of the owner's, parent-consent of a parent's, teen-consent of the learner's own —, each that had a version in force (R130); empty when none had.

day_start.description: The beginning of the family day, the counter's key (not a date: an offset change can repeat a date).

spent_micro_usd.description: Spent that day; the source keeps US dollars by tutor's estimate, here as integer micro-dollars.

reserved_micro_usd.description: In reserve that day, in integer micro-dollars of the dollars the source keeps.

id.description: The ID of the text in the passport of the legal texts, such as parent-consent.

version.description: The number of its version, from 1.
